scale.scope: logical MemoryDB Get calls; no physical IOPS/mainnet extrapolation

root_controls: pinned generic-trie path updates agree with native full-state roots; native verifier checks generated proofs
error_controls: accessed missing/corrupt content does not return successful zero
storage failure is not consensus-invalid nonce
cancelled caller does not poison cached view
zero-fee admission cannot use unreadable nonce/balance
metadata readers serialize lazy cache mutation
full export cannot mutate prepared source code
publication: master-targeted state correction; current-head CI and composed source checked separately
